method: Each complete sportsbook quote is devigged separately, then probabilities are averaged by market family. Opta supplies a direct 90-minute 1X2 distribution. Polymarket is excluded from fair probability and used only as execution cost. Internal versus external disagreement is retained as a diagnostic and is not penalized.

stage_applicability.reason: The teams optimize trophy probability while these contracts settle on the first 90 minutes. The internal model has no validated final-stage, extra-time-option-value, or state-dependent risk-aversion feature.
stage_applicability.execution_policy: Direct same-market sportsbook and Opta evidence may still price eligible markets. P1/P2/P3 remain diagnostic and cannot directionally move p_center until a final-stage calibration passes an ex-ante historical validation.

decision_parameters.p_trade_rule: For 1X2, p_external = 0.75 * sportsbook consensus + 0.25 * Opta; for O/U 2.5, p_external = sportsbook consensus. The World Cup final is classified PARTIAL_OOD_FINAL_STAGE, so p_center = p_external and P1/P2/P3 are diagnostic only for both eligible families. uncertainty = max(0.5pp, 0.5 * sportsbook source range + base and family-specific data-quality penalties). Internal versus external disagreement is diagnostic only and is not an uncertainty penalty. Directional p_trade is p_center - uncertainty; complement outcomes are constructed coherently before applying uncertainty.
